implemented.vault: Independent AES-256-GCM/HKDF outer wrapping; canonical inner signatures and codecs retained.

implemented.eight_sphere: All fully defined attachment formulas implemented as a standalone reference module. No complete calibrated model or cipher binding.
implemented.local127: First login atomically checks the signed address register, allocates an unused rmail@127.0.0.2..254 alias to the authenticated mailbox, and records immutable ownership. Existing 127 mailbox identities are reused. Repeated login preserves identity and credentials; startup verifies reservation and ownership journals.
implemented.inbox: One mailbox shell at the root and all saved mail/Internet/desk URLs. Authenticated owner-scoped received folders, message retrieval, and combined local/Internet Sent view.
implemented.backup_export: Authenticated encrypted backups/default exports and independently protected portable ZIP recovery; exclusive new recovery outputs.
implemented.console: Standard WebView2 host; visible loading/failure/retry; protected UI readiness at every saved mail URL. Recoverable subprocess exits preserve the live interface. Main browser/renderer exits fail; unresponsiveness has bounded grace/recovery. Privacy-limited diagnostics rotate in two64KiB files. Origin/resource/frame/permission/devtools restrictions retained. Local mail WebSocket resources use the exact configured literal origin/path. User-initiated FileReadWrite access is limited to an allowed console HTTP origin for streamed file saves.
implemented.startup: Full launch inventory freshly SHA-256 checked, fresh per-file ancestor checks and independent Node pin. Verifier source bound/checked before compilation. Visible progress/cancel and owned-process cleanup.
implemented.outbound_internet_mail: Authenticated per-account Internet email. First connection uses the signed assigned 127 sender and bracketed SMTP greeting automatically; ordinary and game mailbox users can send. Sender settings and outbox are owner-scoped. Direct DNS MX/SMTP port25 sends require verified STARTTLS. Encrypted signed durable outbox and immutable retry/crash results preserved.
implemented.outbound_network_scope: Ordinary runtime DNS/TCP/listener guards retained. A captured, bounded mail capability resolves public recipient MX/A/AAAA and connects only to pinned public SMTP destinations.
implemented.unified_mail: One compose form automatically classifies local mailbox aliases versus public recipient domains. Authenticated assigned From is used for local and default Internet mail. Quote/send route confirmation and immutable Internet attempt replay retained. No delivery-mode or interface picker.
implemented.private_torus: One compose workflow automatically selects registered local or Tor peer @127 recipients. Pinned Ed25519 node cards, X25519 destination encryption, signed disjoint prefix leases and immutable durable receipts; nine nodes, no public DNS or SMTP fallback. Account-owned Inbox, Sent and outbox; copied legacy aliases/history retained. Public Internet sending is refused after private-network activation.
implemented.streaming_attachments: Up to four files per message, no fixed per-file or total file-byte ceiling. Protected 256 KiB chunk upload, scoped AES-GCM file storage, signed manifests and destination-only encrypted Tor chunks. No whole-file buffers; capacity depends on disk and filesystem precision. Signed receipt follows complete file integrity verification and Inbox commit. New backups include encrypted chunk files; own-message streaming downloads and unfinished-transfer cleanup.
